items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: he was in my band for quite a few years. Then, of course, I would always tell my brother, you know, about anybody great like that. And when I rejoined my brother, I took Roy with me, and we got this Chicago job at the Grand Terrace -- Roy Eldridge and Chu Berry and joined John Fletcher

ctx.x: you came to a point where, for one reason or another, you didn't have a job or your band had, you know, stopped a gig or something, did you often automatically go to Fletcher's band, or how did that work out?

Well, we always, as you know, were in constant contact with each other, being in the same city. Fletcher during that time used to exchange arrangements -- write arrangements -- even for Basie, you know, Basie had his great Kansas City band during that time. He had Buck Clayton in that band and Harry Sweets Edison, and Basie was making his little tours up through there, and he would come in and stop at the same hotel right down where Fletcher was playing at the Grand Terrace, you know. And a lot of times, Fletcher…
